correctness.rationale: Haar orthogonality gives the exact residues of the cube. The coefficientwise absolute-value bound reduces all phases to nonnegative magnitudes. An exact polynomial certificate checks every order-3/4/5/6/no-alias formula, and each is strictly increasing in the endpoint product at fixed energy. The one-variable derivative factorizations were verified by integer polynomial arithmetic; roots are uniquely positive by explicit factorizations, Descartes and quadratic formulas. Phase rigidity from the two contributions to the quadratic cube coefficient, then finite-residue alignment, proves all and only stated equality cases. The proof treats zero coefficients and the infinite-order boundary; no finite tests are claimed to prove an infinite statement.

value.rationale: The exact sharp sixth moment is a natural measure of concentration for a three-dimensional Fourier synthesis space. Orders five and six introduce genuinely new torsion alias terms not present at the fourth moment; order seven is the sharp stabilization threshold. The nontrivial quintic optimizer and complete phase rigidity classification are mathematically motivated and not a renaming or parameter substitution of the known fourth-moment result. The result is restricted to this natural class and claims no wider application without evidence.
